description: **`selene init`** — offline install of the embedded cooperation harness into a git repo, with ownership-aware `--refresh`/`--force`, lattice default-on, hooks default-on (`--no-hooks` opt-out), and global hooks-paths registration.
**.selene semantics** — fork-native `.selene` repo config dir (skills/commands, rules, hooks, workflows, agents, plugins) with `.grok` kept as legacy fallback at every surface.
**Windows tests** — `parse_login_env_capture` tests cfg-gated to match their unix-only helper.
**Honest identity** — the system prompt no longer hardcodes "released by xAI"; `selene-k3` introduces itself as Kimi K3 via `system_prompt_label`.
**Selene crescent** welcome logo — geometric braille moon and sparkle, both size tiers.
**Kimi K3 (Modal)** is the compiled-in default model; the fork home lives at `~/.selene`.
**Native Windows build** — protoc probe, `LNK1318` PDB link, stack reserve, harness fixes.
